description: Build a CSV parser that handles quoted fields and escapes
prompt: Write a Python module with: (1) `parse_csv_line(line: str, delimiter: str = ',') -> list[str]` that correctly handles quoted fields, escaped quotes (""), and embedded delimiters. (2) `parse_csv(text: str, delimiter: str = ',', has_header: bool = True) -> list[dict] | list[list]` that parses multi-line CSV text. If has_header=True, return list of dicts with header keys. Include test_parse_csv() testing: simple rows, quoted fields with commas, escaped quotes, multiline within quotes.
expected_behavior: Parses RFC 4180 compliant CSV including quoted fields, embedded commas, and escaped double-quotes

validation_criteria.l5: Handles: quoted fields, embedded delimiters, escaped quotes, header mapping
